free_tier.stated: no free cloud server; the cheapest is SC-0 at USD 3 a month or USD 30 a year: 1 vCPU, 512 MB RAM, 10 GB NVMe, a shared IPv4 with SSH and 20 forwarded ports, a 25 Mbps network, 1 TB of transfer a month, full root on KVM and a 25 GB encrypted backup vault included. SC-1 is USD 7 a month or USD 70 a year: 1 vCPU, 1 GB RAM, 20 GB NVMe, a dedicated IPv4 with all 65535 ports, 50 Mbps down and 40 Mbps up, 3 TB of transfer a month and a 100 GB backup vault. SC-2 is USD 12 a month and SC-3 USD 20 a month. The same vendor also sells a free 10 GB Restic backup vault, a separate backup offer.

per_object_cap.notes: not applicable to a cloud server

retention.stated: unverified: the cloud-servers page states no retention window for a server disk after cancellation
retention.notes: the vault snapshot history belongs to the separate backup offer

egress.terms: SC-0 includes a 25 Mbps network and 1 TB of transfer a month; SC-1 and up include 3 TB a month on 50 Mbps down and 40 Mbps up. A server that reaches its allowance has its networking paused until the 1st of the next month; the server keeps running and nothing is deleted, and overage is not billed automatically.
egress.free_allowance: 1 TB a month on SC-0, 3 TB a month on SC-1 and up

interface_detail: SSH on the shared IPv4 and its forwarded ports on SC-0, on the dedicated IPv4 from SC-1; a portal handles status, power, credentials, IPv6, firewall, cancellation and resumption; not probed
tooling: full root on a KVM guest over SSH; the portal handles status, power, credentials, IPv6, firewall, cancellation and resumption. Each server includes an encrypted backup vault that standard Restic writes to from inside the guest
chaining: SC-0 is a 512 MB server at USD 3 a month whose shared IPv4 carries SSH and 20 forwarded ports only; a dedicated address with all 65535 ports starts at SC-1 at USD 7 a month. Every server bundles a backup vault: 25 GB on SC-0 and 100 GB on SC-1.

limits.value: 1 TB of transfer a month on SC-0 and 3 TB on SC-1 and up, with networking paused at the allowance until the 1st of the next month; SC-0 has a 25 Mbps network and shares one IPv4, with SSH plus 20 forwarded ports

limits_note: the binding count is the monthly transfer allowance (1 TB on SC-0, 3 TB on SC-1 and up); SC-0 also has a shared IPv4 with 20 forwarded ports
binding_note: the binding count is the monthly transfer allowance (1 TB on SC-0, 3 TB on SC-1 and up); the server stays up and its networking pauses at the cap

identity_cost.detail: Sign-up asks for an email address and a password, with an optional full name; no card, phone or ID field is on the form. Paid servers can be paid by card through Stripe, by PayPal, or by on-chain Bitcoin, so a card is one of three payment choices and not required. The server order form was not read, so any further field it asks for is unverified: behind a sign-up.
